test_apply_with_string_funcs: test applying string function names like sum, mean, min, max, std via DataFrame.agg or DataFrame.apply
test_apply_np_reducer: test applying numpy reducer function names like mean, median, std, var via DataFrame.agg or DataFrame.apply
test_apply_np_transformer: test applying numpy transformer function names like abs, ceil, cos, cumsum, exp, log, sqrt, square via DataFrame.transform or DataFrame.apply
test_agg_cython_table_series: test Series.agg with cython table reduction functions like sum, max, min, all, any, mean, prod, std, var, median
test_transform_groupby_kernel_series: test Series.transform with groupby kernel operations like fillna, ngroup, matching GroupBy.transform behavior
